name: Bierzo
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Bierzo reds are made mostly from Mencía, and its whites mostly from Godello.
The reds smell of red and black fruit and violets, and taste fresh, with medium to full body.
The whites show white and stone fruit, citrus and white flowers, with freshness and medium to full body.
Barrel-aged reds add vanilla, coconut, toast and spice.

blurb.text: A DO in the northwest of León province. Allowed grapes include Mencía for red and Godello for white, plus Doña Blanca, Palomino and Alarije.
